weather_report:
The nocturnal skies above San Francisco are currently painted with a gentle haze of cloud, as the city quietly hums into the early morning hours. A balmy whisper of a breeze stirs at just a mile per hour, offering a hint of comfort as the temperature holds at a mild 59 degrees. As the day breaks, however, the city will greet sunshine that promises warmth, with the mercury reaching towards 84, offering a delightful contrast to the coolness of the night. By afternoon, this wealth of warmth will ease into a more tempered 80 degrees, accompanied by a friendly gust of a wind that will remind you that you are, indeed, in a city kissed by the ocean.

Today’s clarity is a well-deserved blessing after the shadows of fog that often cloak this urban landscape. The absence of that familiar cool marine layer is a joyful surprise, allowing for expansive views from the towering heights of Sutro. Dress in light layers to embrace the warm embrace of the sun while keeping a cozy option handy for those momentary breezes that dance down the avenues. With such a charming day before you, perhaps stroll through the local markets filled with artisan goods, or settle into a hidden café with a view of the bay, savoring the life that moves around you as the city awakens. The allure of this vibrant day invites you to take it slow, observing how the world stretches toward the horizon under the crystalline sky.
